name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd
about: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing, developing and marketing a wide range of branded and generic formulations and Active Pharma Ingredients (APIs). The company and its subsidiaries has various manufacturing facilities spread across the world with trading and other incidental and related activities extending to global market. [1] It is the largest pharmaceutical company in India. [2]

flags.text: Profit compounded 38.3% vs revenue 11.8% over 5 years: margin expansion has done the work. Check it can last

business.what: Sun Pharma is a global specialty and generics drugmaker. It sells branded and generic formulations in India, the US, emerging markets and rest of world, plus innovative medicines such as Ilumya and Unloxcyt. Revenue comes from product sales.

segments.name: India formulations
segments.comment: Grew 17.3%, ahead of market; volume growth drove Pharmarack expansion.

segments.name: US business
segments.comment: Down 8.2% on lenalidomide erosion; Ilumya slowed, though up 6.5% sequentially.

segments.name: Global Innovative Medicines
segments.comment: Up 6.9%; overlaps US and ex-US lines; Ilumya US slowdown weighed.

segments.name: Emerging markets formulations
segments.comment: Up 7.6% (7.4% constant currency); Ilumya growing in Romania and Brazil.

segments.name: Rest of world formulations
segments.comment: Higher than last year; exact growth rate not stated.

ledger.promise: High single-digit consolidated revenue growth in FY27
ledger.quote: we expect high single -digit consolidated top line growth for FY27 based on our current understanding of the regulatory and macro environment
ledger.actual: H1 FY27 revenue 31,499 vs 28,329 in H1 FY26, up 11.2% (Q1 +10.5%, Q2 +11.9%). Ahead of the guided range so far. Reiterated on Q1 and Q2 calls.

ledger.promise: FY27 R&D spend at 6-7% of sales
ledger.quote: We expect our FY27 R&D spend to be 6% to 7% of the sales for the next year.
ledger.actual: R&D ran below plan in Q1 and Q2 by management's own account. Q2 call expects a sharp ramp in Q3 and H2 catch-up. These materials give no R&D figures.

ledger.promise: Effective tax rate around 25% in FY27 and beyond
ledger.quote: We expect the effective tax rate to be in the range of 25%.
ledger.actual: One quarter later, the Q1 FY27 call reported a 27.8% ETR and guided to a similar range until Organon closes, because India tax benefits are running out.

ledger.promise: Elevated Q4 FY26 US and other spends to normalize, lifting EBITDA margin
ledger.quote: Some of these spends were elevated for the quarter, and we should see it normalizing in the subsequent quarters.
ledger.actual: EBITDA margin was 27.1% in Q4 FY26, 28.9% in Q1 FY27 and 29.3% in Q2 FY27. That is still below the 31.1-31.9% of Q1-Q3 FY26.

ledger.promise: Organon deal to close in 6-9 months, i.e. Q4 FY27
ledger.quote: we expect this deal to close in about six to nine month time.
ledger.actual: Q1 and Q2 FY27 calls both say it is on track for Q4 FY27 / early 2027, subject to remaining closing conditions. Not closed as of the Q2 call.

ledger.promise: Fund the deal with $2-2.5 billion of own cash; the rest from committed bank financing
ledger.quote: The financing is going to be partly out of our own cash surplus which could be in the range of $2 billion to $2.5 billion and the balance would be funded through the committed financing from our banks.
ledger.actual: Not closed yet. Q2 FY27 call adds that borrowing cost should be roughly in line with Organon's current cost. Borrowings are 3,241 for FY27 vs 4,627 for FY26.

ledger.promise: Net debt around 2.3x combined EBITDA after closing
ledger.quote: if we look at the debt in context of the multiples of combined company EBITDA, then I think it's around 2.3 times
ledger.actual: Depends on closing, expected Q4 FY27. No post-closing balance sheet yet.

ledger.promise: About $350 million of Organon synergies in 2-4 years
ledger.quote: there are significant potential synergies that could come out, which we have highlighted could be in the range of about $350 million which could be materialized in the next two to four years.
ledger.actual: The deal has not closed, so no synergies can be measured. Not repeated on the Q1 or Q2 FY27 calls.

ledger.quote: And yes, it is the EPS accretive from day one, yes.
ledger.actual: Not closed. Before closing, deal costs already weigh on profit: Q2 FY27 PAT 1,995, down 36% from 3,125 in Q2 FY26.

ledger.promise: Combined revenue of $12.4 billion, with innovative medicines at 27%
ledger.quote: I think the combined company's revenues will be $12.4 billion.
ledger.actual: Pro forma figure only. Management said it would update the numbers at closing (Q4 FY26 call p24).

ledger.promise: Acquisition-related exceptional charges to continue in later quarters
ledger.quote: There would be additional charges on this account in the subsequent quarters.
ledger.actual: Q2 FY27 had exceptional items (Organon costs plus a litigation provision). PBT was 3,159 against EBITDA of 4,744. No full estimate yet; more costs may come late.

ledger.promise: Biosimilar business growth to rise above 13% in 2-3 years
ledger.quote: the entire business of biosimilar which is today growing by 13% can even grow higher in next two to three years.
ledger.actual: These materials have no segment data, and no later call reports biosimilar growth.

current_guidance.quote: Regarding the guidance, I think we'll stick to what guidance we have given at the beginning of the year.

current_guidance.target: 6-7% of sales for the full year, weighted to H2 with a sharp ramp in Q3
current_guidance.quote: as that ramps up, we should be able to meet the overall guidance that we've shared with people.
We are now on track to close the transaction as per earlier communicated timelines, that is Q4 of FY27.

current_guidance.target: About 27.8% (Q1 FY27 level) until Organon closes, vs 25% guided in May
current_guidance.quote: we expect this range to sort of continue for some time until we have the Organon transaction completed.

current_guidance.target: Roughly in line with Organon's current borrowing cost
current_guidance.quote: the rate of borrowing should be more or less in line with the current borrowing cost of Organon.

current_guidance.target: Continue until day 1, possibly back-ended; full estimate at closing
current_guidance.quote: the acquisition-relating cost will continue until day 1, and some of these could be back-ended

current_guidance.target: Soft launch November 2026, full launch in following months
current_guidance.quote: We are planning for a soft launch in November with a full launch in the following months.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: Revenue is running ahead of the high single-digit guide (H1 FY27 +11.2%), margins have recovered from the Q4 FY26 low as promised, and the Organon timeline has held for two calls. But the 25% tax-rate guide was dropped after one quarter, R&D has run below plan for two quarters with the full-year target resting on an H2 catch-up, and the deal promises that matter most for valuation (synergies, leverage, EPS accretion) cannot be tested until closing.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Adjusted for lenalidomide, EBITDA growth has outpaced revenue growth.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: On reported numbers, Q2 FY27 EBITDA grew 4.8% (4,744 vs 4,527) while revenue grew 11.9%; margin fell to 29.3% from 31.3%. For H1, EBITDA is up 3.8% against revenue up 11.2%. The lenalidomide adjustment cannot be checked with these materials.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Elevated Q4 spends were one-off and would normalize in later quarters.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Margin rose from 27.1% (Q4 FY26) to 28.9% (Q1) and 29.3% (Q2), but stays about 2 points below the 31.1-31.9% of Q1-Q3 FY26. R&D, still under-spent, is due to ramp up in H2.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Underlying business is growing; the drop in reported PAT comes from exceptional items and a higher tax rate.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q2 FY27 PAT 1,995, down 36% YoY, with PBT 3,159 against EBITDA 4,744. TTM PAT is 10,987, below FY26's 11,509, even though TTM revenue rose to 61,631 from 58,462.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Holding high single-digit revenue guidance for FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: H1 growth of 11.2% is above the guided range. Keeping the guide unchanged implies about 6-7% growth in H2, or a conservative guide.

bull.point: Revenue is growing faster than guided
bull.evidence: Q1 FY27 +10.5% and Q2 FY27 +11.9% YoY; H1 31,499 vs 28,329 (+11.2%) against a high single-digit FY27 guide.

bull.point: Margins have recovered from the Q4 FY26 low
bull.evidence: EBITDA margin 27.1% in Q4 FY26, 28.9% in Q1 FY27, 29.3% in Q2 FY27, in line with the promise that spending would normalize.
bull.source: Q4 FY26 call p4; reported numbers

bull.point: The Organon deal is on schedule, and the balance sheet going in is light
bull.evidence: Closing reaffirmed for Q4 FY27 on two calls. Borrowings 3,241 for FY27 vs 4,627 for FY26; FY26 cash from operations 12,419. Management targets about $350 million of synergies.
bull.source: Q2 FY27 call p5; Q4 FY26 call p9; reported numbers

bear.point: Profit is falling while revenue grows
bear.evidence: Q2 FY27 PAT 1,995 vs 3,125 YoY; TTM PAT 10,987 below FY26 11,509. The ETR guide was raised from 25% to about 27.8% within one quarter, and more acquisition costs are expected, possibly back-ended.
bear.source: reported numbers; Q1 FY27 call p4; Q2 FY27 call p15

bear.point: H2 margins face pressure from R&D catch-up
bear.evidence: R&D has run below plan in Q1 and Q2. Meeting the 6-7% guide needs a sharp Q3 ramp, while H1 EBITDA grew only 3.8% against revenue growth of 11.2%.
bear.source: Q2 FY27 call p6, p9; reported numbers

bear.evidence: Post-closing net debt guided at about 2.3x combined EBITDA; synergies and EPS accretion cannot be tested yet. Debtor days rose from 85 (FY24) to 97 (FY26) and inventory days to 363. FY26 investing outflow was 10,405.
bear.source: Q4 FY26 call p4; reported numbers
